rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone feeling emotionally troubled or anxious.

example.english: With so much pressure at work lately, I’m always angsty.
example.traditional: 最近返工壓力咁大，我成日都好焦慮。
example.jyutping: zeoi3 gan6 faan1 gung1 aat3 lik6 gam3 daai6 ngo5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hou2 ziu1 leoi6

rows.note: Use this when the person seems weighed down by worries or preoccupied with personal troubles.

example.english: Ming has been angsty lately and won’t say what’s wrong when I ask.
example.traditional: 阿明呢排成日心事重重，問佢咩事都唔肯講。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 ni1 paai4 seng4 jat6 sam1 si6 cung4 cung4 man6 keoi5 me1 si6 dou1 m4 hang2 gong2
